lines.text: God tells Zechariah to take an offering from exiles who arrived from Babylon and go to the house of Josiah son of Zephaniah.
Zechariah is to make a crown of silver and gold and set it on the head of Joshua son of Jehozadak.
The LORD of Hosts says a man named the Branch will branch out from His place and build the altar of the LORD.
The Branch will sit on His throne and rule, and He will be a prophet on His throne.
Even those far away will come and build the temple, and this will happen if the people diligently obey the voice of the LORD.
